notes: Reached DIRECTLY with plain urllib (HTTP 200) exactly as notes/29.md described - no proxy, no impersonation. robots.txt is the stock Shopify agentic robots (it explicitly says public collection HTML is crawlable) and names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu in the homepage HTML (ul.nav__list / nav__sublist / nav__subsublist), which is a true 3-level tree here, unlike the flat Decor side seen in the Home-Decor pass. The 'Furniture' department (/collections/furniture-categories) has 5 room sub-departments - Living Room, Dining Room, Bedroom, Office, Outdoor - each with its own product-type leaves. The site ALSO carries sibling type-based top-level departments (Sofas, Chairs, Tables, Bedroom, Storage) whose members are mostly the same collections; I emitted each collection exactly once and added grouping rows 'Chairs', 'Tables', 'Storage' only for the five collections that appear nowhere in the Furniture department (Swivel + Recliners, Ottomans + Poufs + Stools, Game Tables, Media Storage, Cabinets), so there are no duplicate rows. I re-scanned the main content of all 5 room landing pages and the 4 type landing pages for additional collection tiles: they surface no subcategory beyond the mega-menu, so the leaves recorded here are the deepest valid level. The Shopify 'Product Type' facet was deliberately NOT split into rows - per the prior pass on this store that metafield is an unreliable overlapping taxonomy (facet values sum above the collection total), not a real hierarchy. COUNTS: every leaf count is the RENDERED header N products. Shopify products_count from collections.json was not used at all (known-inflated). VERIFICATION: all 31 leaves were independently re-counted by paging /collections//products.json?limit=250&page=N to exhaustion and counting unique product IDs - 31 of 31 matched the rendered header EXACTLY (e.g. side-tables 1867=1867, swivel-recliners 1010=1010, accent-chairs 1536=1536, sleepers 17=17). The counts also discriminate per category (no constant site-wide number), and every page's h1 matched the category requested. GROUPING ROWS: the 8 parent nodes are landing pages with category tiles and no ProductCountDesktop header at all, confirming they are navigational, so they carry qty=null/link=null. CONTENT CHECKS: title-scanned bookcases-shelves (bookcases/bookshelves/etagere - freestanding furniture shelving, not wall shelves; product_type 183/199 'Furniture - Storage'), media-storage (media consoles/entertainment consoles/credenzas), cabinets (door cabinets, 236/250 'Furniture - Storage'), ottomans-poufs-stools (ottomans/poufs/stools filed by the site under Chairs, i.e. seating) - all genuine furniture, all kept. EXCLUDED: Mattresses (/collections/mattresses, 11 products) - bedding not furniture per the brief, and the site splits Beds from Mattresses so no roll-up problem; the whole Decor department (Art, Wall Decor, Rugs, Lighting, Pillows, Mirrors, Books, Tabletop, Bedding, Home Fragrance, Plants & Planters) - other tasks' scope; and the §3 junk nodes (What's New, Best Sellers *, Sale/Flash Sale/Tent Sale, In-Stock, Free Shipping, Made in the USA, brand pages such as Four Hands / Bernhardt / Noir / Sunpan / TOV, and the 207 'room-ideas-*' inspiration sets in the collections sitemap).
